component.name: CalibRaw
component.summary: Develop RAW photos with non-destructive editing

description.p: CalibRaw is a GPU-accelerated RAW photo editor. Browse your photo library, develop camera RAW files, and fine-tune color, tone, and detail in one workflow. Adjustments are saved in sidecar files so your original photos remain intact.

Shape your images with tone curves, color wheels, and targeted color adjustments. Apply lens corrections, recover highlights, and combine bracketed exposures with HDR merge. Brush, gradient, and shape masks let you make local adjustments, while optional AI tools process masks, noise reduction, and object removal on your device after downloading their models.

ul.li: Develop RAW files from a wide range of cameras, including Fujifilm X-Trans sensors
Adjust exposure, white balance, tone curves, and individual color ranges
Correct lens distortion, chromatic aberration, and vignetting
Apply local masks and creative effects with independent adjustments
Export finished photos, including lossless JPEG XL images
AI tools: subject/sky selection, object removal, denoise (models downloaded on first use)

description.p: This is a community package of CalibRaw, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream AppImage unmodified.

screenshot.caption: Develop RAW photos with color, tone, and local adjustment tools
Browse photos in the library before editing
AI subject mask for selective adjustments

description.p: This release adds sharing and opens RAW files from cameras that LibRaw does not support yet.

ul.li: Export and share a photo in one step
Open RAW files from newer cameras, such as the Nikon Z 5 II, through Rawler
